provenance.how_to_verify: Open the Indigo Book (https://law.resource.org/pub/us/code/blue/IndigoBook.html, CC0), T3 New York (McKinney's Consolidated Laws; Uniform Dist. Ct. Act), and compare the form and examples with this pattern.

positive.text: The rule is N.Y. Uniform Dist. Ct. Act § 41 (McKinney 2013).
Small claims fall under N.Y. Uniform City Ct. Act § 1801.
See N.Y. Uniform Just. Ct. Act § 204(a) and N.Y. Uniform District Court Act § 29.

negative: The N.Y. Uniform Dist. Ct. Act governs Nassau County.
New York's uniform court acts date from 1963.
Uniform district courts sit in 2 counties.

note: Outranks secondary us.uniform.uniform_act (55), which otherwise reads the New York act as a model uniform act.
